rationale: This is a general synonym for Langerhans cell histiocytosis, a histiocytic neoplasm that involves a wide range of anatomic sites including bone, skin, lung, soft tissue, lymph nodes, liver, spleen and CNS. It is not restricted to a proper subset of the code's ceiling sites.

By definition the disseminated/multisystem form of LCH involves multiple organ systems (bone marrow, liver, spleen, skin, lung, lymph nodes, GI tract, CNS, bone), making it the least anatomically restricted form; it is not confined to a proper subset of the code's ceiling sites.

Letterer-Siwe disease is the severe acute multisystemic form of LCH affecting high-risk organs (bone marrow, liver, spleen) plus skin, lymph nodes, GI tract, CNS, lung and bone; it is the most widely disseminated variant and is not restricted to a proper subset of the code's ceiling sites.

Nonlipid reticuloendotheliosis is an older synonym for Letterer-Siwe disease / disseminated LCH, the acute multisystem form involving multiple organ systems (bone marrow, liver, spleen, skin, lymph nodes, lung, bone, CNS); it is not confined to a proper subset of the code's ceiling sites.
